title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-p0rc: _compute_th missing MAC_stub/EAD_stub prefix per RFC 9528 §3.4
description:
Per RFC 9528 §3.4, the transcript hash TH(X) is defined as H(MAC_stub | EAD_stub | X) where MAC_stub = 0x07 and EAD_stub = 0x40. The _compute_th function in edhoc.py line 127 does  without prepending these two bytes, so all transcript hashes (TH_2, TH_3, TH_4) are non-conformant.

This affects every call to _compute_th — both initiator and responder sides, all message processing stages.

File: python/src/lichen/crypto/edhoc.py:125-127
